sessions.session_title: Check-in conversation – brief status update (Daisy Boynton)
sessions.notes_text: Called to touch base. He said he sent pics of his tattoos, but I never received them. He said he'd send them again. Had a fight with the woman he's been living with. Went to his mom's house (where he is currently). His anxiety is bad because he's worried about his PO understanding that he was uncomfortable and had to leave his housing situation (talks to her at 10 today). Still no employment, offered a 3rd shift job but his transportation didn't work for it. Only wants me to send him jobs that start at $20/hr. Uses a local lady (a "bootleg Uber") for transportation. Says he was pick pocketed this weekend and lost his ID, money, and social security card. Wants help getting his social security card.
sessions.next_conversation_topics: Follow up on Reentry Navigation goals and Briefcase Gate 1–4 items.

sessions.notes_text:
Phone Intake/Screening: Brandon James, 10/23/26

Background/Referral: Brandon is a former participant/employee. He was previously connected through Terrence, and Ms. Carla did his orientation. He worked T-shirt inspection on the conveyor line, checking for pinholes, smudges, and print offset. He describes himself as fast and would like to return to similar work.

Housing: He lives in his own home on 2 9th Road in Columbia. Housing is stable.

Documents:

Birth certificate: in process
SS card: in process
State ID: temporary issued 10/22, physical copy pending by mail
Driver’s license: never had one, which he attributes to anxiety

Transportation: He owns a 2021 Acura TLX, and a friend/employee drives him. The driver is available 24/7, so transportation to and from the program is covered.

Health/Behavioral Health: He was previously prescribed hydroxyzine for anxiety and is not currently taking it. He wants to re-engage with mental health care. He is still in contact with his doctor and says he has this covered. He reports no alcohol use and past marijuana use, not current. He is okay with weekly drug testing, including THC.

Physical: He broke his right hand and it was never reset, so it occasionally locks up. He reports this won’t limit his work and says he is legally and physically able to work.

Criminal History:

First arrest at age 13, juvenile arbitration, no conviction
4 total arrests, 2 convictions/sentences:
State: 4 years
Federal: 15 years for illegal firearm possession (2011), served 14 years. He was incarcerated from age 26 to 41.
Most recent: arrested 7/23/25 and released 10/16/26, about 15 months
No drug trafficking, no sex offense, no pending charges
Father has an extensive record; mother’s record is clean

Supervision: He is on federal probation/supervision for 2.5 years, with PO Ms. Smith. He met with her Monday and is in compliance. His PO’s main requirement is maintaining employment.

Other: No child support owed. No weekly obligations conflict with the 9–3 program hours.

Education: Completed 9th grade, no GED.

Work History: Self-employed in landscaping and car washing, with 6 years as his longest stretch. Jobs ended due to incarceration.

Certifications: Culinary arts, business management, and conversational Spanish.

Plan:

Added to the waitlist with an estimated wait of about 3 weeks or less, possibly shorter or longer depending on graduations. I’ll update him as he moves up.
Enrolled in Reentry Navigation while he waits. His goals are:
Driver’s license (process and test scheduling)
Tattoo removal options in the Columbia area
I’ll build a case plan, research both goals, and follow up next week by call or text.
If a call doesn’t ring through, text him. He was told he can text or call this number anytime.
sessions.next_conversation_topics: Follow up on Reentry Navigation goals and Briefcase Gate 1–4 items.

sessions.session_title: Barrier removal – problem-solving or coordination support (Daisy Boynton)
sessions.notes_text: Called Brandon to let him know the first step in getting his DL is going to the DMV with his ID and taking the permit test. I'm going to send him some permit practice tests to prepare before that. Also let him know about tattoo removal services. Removery is a program that offers free tattoo removal for people with a criminal record. I'm going to take a look at the application process and follow up with him tomorrow about what info we need.
sessions.next_conversation_topics: Follow up on Reentry Navigation goals and Briefcase Gate 1–4 items.
